nodes.summary: Algebraic rewriting of the ratio `binomProbHalf n k / gaussianApproxHalf n k` using Stirling's formula, separating it into a Stirling-sequence factor, a square-root factor, a power-of-`n` factor, and an exponential correction.
nodes.title: Stirling decomposition of the binomial-to-Gaussian ratio

nodes.summary: For any binomial success-index sequence whose standardized displacement converges to `x`, the point mass is equivalent to the Gaussian expression evaluated at the fixed limit `x`. The number of trials may follow any natural-valued sequence tending to infinity.
nodes.title: Binomial point mass is equivalent to a fixed Gaussian value

nodes.summary: The binomial point mass and its Gaussian approximation are asymptotically equivalent along the sequence `k = localDMLIndex x n`: `binomProbHalf n k ~ gaussianApproxHalf n k` as `n → ∞`. Combines Stirling's formula with the power-factor and entropy estimates.
nodes.title: Binomial point mass is equivalent to its Gaussian approximation

nodes.summary: The point mass `P(B_n = k) = C(n,k) / 2ⁿ` for a `Binomial(n, 1/2)` success count `B_n`.
nodes.title: Binomial point mass with success probability one half

nodes.summary: The product of the power factor `nⁿ / (kᵏ (n-k)^{n-k} 2ⁿ)` with the Gaussian correction `exp((k - n/2)² / (n/2))`, evaluated at `k = localDMLIndex x n`, tends to `1` as `n → ∞`. This is the key analytic estimate behind the local DeMoivre–Laplace limit theorem.
nodes.title: The corrected binomial power factor tends to one

nodes.summary: Third-order Taylor bound for the symmetric entropy expansion: `|(1+u) log(1+u) + (1-u) log(1-u) - u²| ≤ 6 |u|³` whenever `|u| < 1/2`. Used to control the deviation of the binomial coefficient from its Gaussian approximation.
nodes.title: Cubic bound on the symmetric entropy residual

nodes.summary: Rewriting of `m!` in terms of Mathlib's `Stirling.stirlingSeq`: `m! = stirlingSeq(m) · √(2m) · (m/e)^m`.
nodes.title: Factorial in terms of the Stirling sequence

nodes.summary: The Gaussian (local CLT) approximation to `binomProbHalf n k`, `√(2/(π n)) · exp(-(k - n/2)² / (n/2))`.
nodes.title: Gaussian approximation to the symmetric binomial point mass

nodes.summary: The source's random-walk local limit theorem: every integer displacement sequence with `2 kₙ / √(2n) → x` has point mass equivalent to `(√(π n))⁻¹ exp(-x²/2)`. The scaling hypothesis itself implies that `n + kₙ` is a valid success index eventually.
nodes.title: Local limit theorem for the simple random walk

nodes.summary: Canonical rounded-sequence corollary of the local De Moivre–Laplace theorem: for any `x ∈ ℝ`, the binomial point mass divided by its moving Gaussian approximation along `localDMLIndex x` tends to `1`. The arbitrary integer-displacement statement with the fixed Gaussian value at `x` is `local_deMoivreLaplace_half_of_tendsto`.
nodes.title: Local De Moivre–Laplace theorem for $p = 1/2$

nodes.summary: Eventually, the deviation `|2k - n|` for `k = localDMLIndex x n` is at most `|x| √n + 2`, since `k = ⌊n/2 + x √n / 2⌋`.
nodes.title: Deviation bound for the De Moivre–Laplace index

nodes.summary: The ratio `localDMLIndex x n / n` tends to `1/2` as `n → ∞`, because the correction `x √n / 2` is `o(n)`.
nodes.title: The De Moivre–Laplace index over n tends to one half

nodes.summary: The rounded success index has standardized displacement converging to `x`.
nodes.title: Standardized displacement of the rounded index converges

nodes.summary: The index `localDMLIndex x n` tends to infinity as `n → ∞`, for any fixed `x : ℝ`.
nodes.title: The De Moivre–Laplace index tends to infinity

nodes.summary: The integer index `k = ⌊n/2 + x·√n/2⌋` corresponding to the parameter `x` in the local DeMoivre–Laplace statement: it picks the lattice point near `n/2 + x √n / 2`, so that `(2k - n)/√n ≈ x`.
nodes.title: Lattice index in the local De Moivre–Laplace theorem

nodes.summary: Identity rewriting the logarithm of the power factor `nⁿ / (kᵏ (n-k)^{n-k} 2ⁿ)` plus the Gaussian exponent `(k - n/2)² / (n/2)` as `-(n/2) · ((1+u) log(1+u) + (1-u) log(1-u) - u²)`, where `u = (2k - n)/n`. This combines the log-binomial expansion with the Gaussian correction.
nodes.title: Logarithm of the binomial power factor

nodes.summary: Companion to `localDMLIndex_ratio_half`: the ratio `(n - k) / n` for `k = localDMLIndex x n` also tends to `1/2`.
nodes.title: The complementary index over n tends to one half

nodes.summary: The complementary index `n - localDMLIndex x n` also tends to infinity, so both `k` and `n - k` are eventually arbitrarily large.
nodes.title: The complementary De Moivre–Laplace index tends to infinity

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
